description:
Introduced to the Mercian fleet in 1951, and named after the famous velodrome in Milan, this was our first dedicated track frame. A single fixed gear brings the clean uncluttered look to this model, with a single front brake to keep you road legal. A classically beautiful looking bike.

Can be built fixed for road use with one brake, freewheel with two, or brakeless for track use.

Crafted by hand in our Derby workshop, the Vigorelli is a sleek racing bike meticulously crafted for peak performance on both road and track.

Its steel frame, manufactured with Reynolds 853 Pro Team double butted tubing, blends stiffness with smooth handling, offering agility and responsive power transfer. Built for speed, this bike perfectly balances traditional craftsmanship with modern racing precision.

Available as frame-only or fully assembled: choose our assembly package — or we can help you build up the assembly to your own specification.
